description: Phase 7 - UI unification under `ui/`. Move `gui/` -> `ui/`, `cli/` -> `ui/cli/`, `tui/` -> `ui/tui/`. Add a `ui/Cargo.toml` workspace manifest and a shared `ui/ipc-client/` crate that wraps the gRPC client over UDS / named pipe. Replace every `reqwest` HTTP call in CLI/TUI/Tauri with the new ipc-client. Remove `tokio-tungstenite` from the TUI; Tauri events / gRPC streaming replace WebSocket. Tauri commands in `src-tauri/` become 1:1 forwarders to kernel RPCs - zero business logic in `ui/`.
steps: Create `ui/` as the top-level UI workspace. Move `gui/*` (everything: src/, src-tauri/, package.json, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.node.json, index.html, README.md) into `ui/` so the layout becomes `ui/src/`, `ui/src-tauri/`, `ui/package.json`, etc.

Create `ui/ipc-client/` crate scaffold: `ui/ipc-client/Cargo.toml`, `ui/ipc-client/src/lib.rs`. The crate depends on `tonic`, `prost`, `tokio`, `agentos-ipc-protocol` (path = `../../native/ipc-protocol`). Expose a `KernelClient` struct with async methods that mirror the kernel gRPC RPCs (submit_task, get_task, list_tasks, stream_events, etc.). The transport selects between Unix domain socket on POSIX, named pipe on Windows, and TCP localhost as fallback - based on env var `AGENTOS_IPC_SOCKET` or default `~/.agentos/ipc.sock`. On Windows use the `tokio` named-pipe types (`NamedPipeClient`); on POSIX use `tokio::net::UnixStream`. Tonic accepts custom connectors via `Endpoint::connect_with_connector`.
Create `ui/Cargo.toml` workspace manifest with members `cli`, `tui`, `src-tauri`, `ipc-client`. Set resolver = 2. Pin shared dependencies in `[workspace.dependencies]`.

Update `ui/cli/Cargo.toml`: drop `reqwest` dependency; add `agentos-ipc-client` (path = `../ipc-client`) and the workspace dependencies. Rewrite `ui/cli/src/ipc.rs` to delegate to `KernelClient`. Delete or replace any HTTP-shaped code in `ui/cli/src/commands/*.rs` so each command translates to a kernel RPC.

Update `ui/tui/Cargo.toml`: drop `reqwest`, drop `tokio-tungstenite`; add `agentos-ipc-client`. Rewrite `ui/tui/src/config.rs` (the file that holds the websocket connector) to use the kernel's gRPC streaming RPCs for live events. Delete WebSocket-only code paths.

Update `ui/src-tauri/Cargo.toml`: drop `reqwest` and `tokio-tungstenite`; add `agentos-ipc-client`. Rewrite Tauri commands in `ui/src-tauri/src/main.rs` (and any cmd modules) so each `#[tauri::command]` is a 1:1 forwarder to a kernel RPC via `KernelClient`. NO business logic remains in src-tauri; it is purely a translation layer between the Tauri renderer and the kernel.

Update `ui/package.json` script names if needed (the existing `dev`, `build`, `tauri:dev`, `tauri:build` are fine). Confirm `ui/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` does not reference an HTTP backend URL; if it does, remove that integration.

Update `.github/workflows/ci.yml` GUI/CLI jobs: change `working-directory: ./gui` to `./ui`, `working-directory: ./cli` to `./ui/cli`, the cache key `gui/package-lock.json` to `ui/package-lock.json`, the cargo workspace path `gui/src-tauri -> target` to `ui -> target`. Pick `pnpm` if you choose to add a pnpm-lock or stick with `npm` and `package-lock.json`. The plan calls for pnpm; switch the CI to use `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and add a `corepack enable` step.

Verify each builds: `cd ui/cli && cargo build`, `cd ui/tui && cargo build`, `cd ui && cargo build --workspace` (this builds cli, tui, src-tauri, ipc-client together), `cd ui && pnpm install && pnpm build` (or `npm ci && npm run build` if pnpm setup is too disruptive in the sandbox).
Delete the empty top-level `gui/`, `cli/`, `tui/` directories: `git rm -r gui cli tui` (each only if its move is complete and the directory is empty/stale).
Run `cd ui && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings`. Fix all warnings.
Commit: `git add -A && git commit -m 'refactor(phase-7): unify GUI/CLI/TUI under ui/ workspace; replace HTTP/WebSocket with gRPC-over-UDS ipc-client'`.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -rn 'reqwest\|tokio-tungstenite' ui/cli ui/tui ui/src-tauri --include='Cargo.toml' --include='*.rs'` returns zero matches in source files (transitive deps via tonic are fine).
`cd ui && pnpm install && pnpm build` (or npm equivalent) returns 0.
All Tauri commands in `ui/src-tauri/src/` are thin forwarders to `KernelClient` - no domain logic.
A single git commit on `refactor/unified-core-runtime` records the changes with message starting `refactor(phase-7):`.
verification: Run `cd ui && cargo build --workspace` and confirm exit 0.
Run `cd ui && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` and confirm exit 0.
Run `cd ui && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` (fall back to `npm ci && npm run build` if pnpm lockfile is not committed yet) and confirm exit 0.
Run `grep -rn 'reqwest::\|tungstenite::' ui/cli/src ui/tui/src ui/src-tauri/src` and confirm zero matches.
Run `ls cli/ tui/ gui/ 2>&1` and confirm 'No such file or directory' for each.
findings: Build verified: `cargo build --workspace --exclude agentos-tauri` and `cargo clippy --workspace --exclude agentos-tauri -- -D warnings` both pass cleanly. Frontend `pnpm install && pnpm build` passes. src-tauri excluded from local build because GTK/webkit headers not available in sandbox (expected). Removed old Cargo.lock files from cli/tui/src-tauri in favor of workspace-level ui/Cargo.lock. Switched from npm to pnpm with pnpm-lock.yaml. esbuild required `pnpm approve-builds` for postinstall script. ratatui 0.26 uses frame.size() not frame.area(). Profile sections removed from non-root packages.
